FOOTER = re.compile(r'^test result: (\w+)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out; finished in ([\d.]+)s$')
BORROWED = sorted(['borrowed_projection_matches_owned_bytes_for_reordered_and_duplicate_columns',

PROBES = sorted(['borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe',

def identity(path):
    b = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(b)).encode() + b'\0' + b).hexdigest()}

def decode_reply(reply):
    return json.loads(reply['structuredContent']['content'])

def load_official(path):
    doc = json.loads(path.read_text())
    values = {}
    for req in doc['requests']:
        assert req['status'] == 'fulfilled'
        v = req['value']
        values[v['url']] = decode_reply(v['value'])
    return doc, values

def only(items):
    assert len(items) == 1, len(items)
    return items[0]

def read_log(kind):
    job, oid = EXPECTED[kind]
    p = ROOT / 'round34-PR200-original-CI-logs' / (job + '-original.log')
    ident = identity(p)
    assert ident['git_blob'] == oid
    raw = p.read_text().splitlines()
    ls = [re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', re.sub(r'^\S+Z ', '', l)) for l in raw]
    def refs(predicate):
        return [{'line': i+1, 'text': l} for i,l in enumerate(ls) if predicate(l)]
    checkout_pos = only([i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if l.endswith('git log -1 --format=%H')])
    checkout = ls[checkout_pos+1]
    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', checkout)
    footers=[]
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        m=FOOTER.fullmatch(l)
        if m:
            status, passed, failed, ignored, measured, filtered, seconds=m.groups()
            footers.append({'line':i+1,'status':status,'passed':int(passed),'failed':int(failed),
                            'ignored':int(ignored),'measured':int(measured),'filtered_out':int(filtered),'seconds':seconds})
    assert footers and all(f['status']=='ok' and f['failed']==0 for f in footers)
    errors=refs(lambda l: '##[error]' in l or bool(re.match(r'^(error:|FAILED\b)',l)))
    assert not errors
    warnings=refs(lambda l: '##[warning]' in l or l.startswith('warning:'))
    assert len(warnings)==1 and 'Node.js 20 is deprecated' in warnings[0]['text']
    jsons=[]
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        if l.startswith('{'):
            try: value=json.loads(l)
            except json.JSONDecodeError: continue
            if isinstance(value,dict):jsons.append({'line':i+1,'value':value})
    return {'identity':ident,'raw':raw,'lines':ls,'refs':refs,'checkout':checkout,
            'checkout_line':checkout_pos+2,'footers':footers,'errors':errors,'warnings':warnings,'jsons':jsons}

def target_sections(log, marker):
    ls=log['lines']; starts=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if marker(l)]
    sections=[]
    for i in starts:
        j=next(j for j in range(i+1,len(ls)) if FOOTER.fullmatch(ls[j]))
        assert not any('Running ' in l for l in ls[i+1:j]), 'unexpected interleaved test target'
        tests=[]
        for k in range(i+1,j):
            m=re.fullmatch(r'test (\S+) \.\.\. (ok|ignored)(.*)',ls[k])
            if m:tests.append({'line':k+1,'name':m[1],'outcome':m[2],'detail':m[3]})
        f=only([f for f in log['footers'] if f['line']==j+1])
        assert sum(t['outcome']=='ok' for t in tests)==f['passed']
        assert sum(t['outcome']=='ignored' for t in tests)==f['ignored']
        sections.append({'target_line':i+1,'target':ls[i],'footer':f,'methods':tests})
    return sections
